item.title: U.S. worker compensation hits four-year low as inflation erodes wages
item.description: (ABC36 NEWS NOW) – New federal data released Wednesday shows that workers’ paychecks aren’t going as far as they used to. According to the latest Employment Cost Index, wages and benefits rose just 3.5 percent year-over-year last quarter — the slowest pace in four years.
